content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCPSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCPSL Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NCPSL Translator Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name and number of vacancies?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Translator, with a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates have a fee of Rs. 250/-, while PwBD and Women candidates are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Translator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Translator post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Translator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35400 - 112400 Per Month, which corresponds to Level-6.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NCPSL Translator Recruitment 2026 must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 02/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a deputation post?
faq.answer: Yes, this recruitment is for a Deputation job type.

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for the application process?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 22 August 2026 and ends on 21 September 2026.
